reviews.review: the pacing is very good, the enemies and guns feel difficult and entertaining rather than an enemy with just more health, large diversity of guns and speed keeps the momentum going as well as the auto load so you don't have to worry about reloading. rail grinding feels a little eh but its only early access and i'm interested to see where the game goes

Why are you not playing this ? This game is fantastic, a great style. fantastic soundtrack and fast paced and fun gameplay! Grab it whenever you can and shoot up some robots as a robot with lots and lots of guns!

Picked up this game after feeling done with Gunfire reborn months ago.
but just recently came back to again.
to my surprise the game is not only fast-phased and heavily relys on your movement.
but even at normal difficulty the game is gonna kick your ass at the start.
Amazing soundtrack.
Alot of fun weapons, some with alt-fires.
TONS of enemies, sometimes a bit overwhelming lol.
Great bosses that arent too easy or too hard.
And Yes Theres also Coop! with different Robots to play aswell!
some people would probably say that "the gameplay is kinda like Doom eternal but rogue-like and with robots"
and yes it pretty much is in someway.
if you're like me who wants another Rogue-like fps with tons of replayability and variety in weapons and characters.
then pick this one up, I doubt you'll be disappointed c;

okay i have put way more hours into this game than i'm willing to admit. 
What can i say? its got a very addicting gameplay style, and the challenge is always there. 
so many different gunplay mix'n'match directions you could take the game and just roll with. 
I stay for the quick challenge of trying to beat the bosses as quick as possible, and reach the "to be continued" screen, whilst mastering all different types of weapons and stats. It just never seems to get old.
